title: Design System: Brick N Papers WhatsApp CRM

display.purpose: Card/module titles, empty states, auth headlines. Feeds shadcn font-heading mapping.

caps.purpose: Sidebar wordmark and small-caps identity labels only.

body.purpose: All forms, tables, lists, buttons, nav labels.

shadows.name: shadow-md-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark-mode equivalent of shadow-md; black tint replaces brown.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default transition easing across the app, lifted from bricknpapers.com's own token.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default submit/primary-action button, e.g. auth page sign-in.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #8A6A2C; color: #FBF8F3; padding: 0 0.625rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: none; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(138,106,44,0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(165,129,63,0.5); border-color: #A5813F; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action button with plain border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #FBF8F3; color: #1A1612; padding: 0 0.625rem; height: 2rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid #ECE3D2; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #ECE3D2; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(165,129,63,0.5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Base form field used throughout auth and app forms.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2rem; width: 100%; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid #D9CCB3; background: transparent; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; color: #1A1612; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #635947; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #8A6A2C; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(165,129,63,0.2); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(220,38,38,0.2); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Base raised container used for auth forms, dashboard panels, list items.
components.html:
Welcome back
Sign in to your account
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(43,38,32,0.08), 0 2px 4px rgba(43,38,32,0.04); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(43,38,32,0.08), 0 2px 4px rgba(43,38,32,0.04), 0 0 0 1px rgba(26,22,18,0.1); padding: 1rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #1A1612; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #635947; margin-top: 0.25rem; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item (active)
components.description: Soft-tint active pill for the primary sidebar navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; color: #635947; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #ECE3D2; color: #1A1612; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: rgba(138,106,44,0.1); color: #8A6A2C; }

components.name: Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: #8A6A2C; color: #FBF8F3; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Brick N Papers' internal CRM is the daylight back room of a craft studio, not a downloaded SaaS shell: warm plaster walls, one disciplined gold accent, and a serif that belongs to the brand rather than a system default. The system is pulled directly from bricknpapers.com's shipped production tokens — the same --gold-*/--plaster-* scales, the same Cormorant/Inter pairing, the same brown-tinted shadow recipe — re-proven for a dense, daily-use Operate-mode tool rather than a marketing page. Nothing here is a stylistic impression of the brand; every token traces to a literal value the site itself ships.

It refuses the category-default "AI dashboard" look this app used to be: near-black surfaces, a neon/violet accent, glowing edges, a swappable multi-theme picker. Warmth is disciplined, not decorative — gold appears on primary actions, active nav state, focus rings, and key numerics, never drenched across a screen. Dark mode exists as a secondary, opt-in re-tint of the same plaster/gold family (the marketing site itself never shipped one), so switching modes never breaks brand identity.
keyCharacteristics: Warm plaster neutrals carry every surface; gold is the single, restrained accent, not a wash.
Display serif (Cormorant Garamond) for titles and empty states; Cormorant SC small caps for section labels; Inter for all body, form, and table text.
Shadows are brown/ink-tinted, never neutral gray.
Exactly one accent theme (gold) — no multi-theme picker exists in the shipped build.
The logo is a supplied brand asset, cropped by fixed math, never redrawn or reinterpreted.

rules.name: The Deepened-Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold-700, not the site's literal gold-600 --accent, carries text and button-fill duty. Gold-600 is demoted to hover/ring/chart-line duty. This is a deliberate accessibility trade over the literal site token, made once, and should not be "corrected" back to gold-600 for text.

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Gold covers primary actions, the active nav pill, focus rings, and key numerics — not backgrounds, not body copy, not decorative fills. If a screen reads gold-heavy, it has drifted from the source.

rules.name: The One-Serif Rule
rules.body: Display serif is reserved for titles and identity moments only. Every interactive/dense surface — forms, tables, lists, buttons — stays in Inter. The pairing exists so brand doesn't slow down daily task work.

rules.name: The Ink-Tint Rule
rules.body: Shadows are never neutral gray. Light mode tints with plaster-800 brown; dark mode tints with black. A gray shadow anywhere in this system is a bug, not a variant.

dos: Do use gold-700 (#8A6A2C) for any text or button-fill accent use, and reserve gold-600 (#A5813F) for hover/ring/decorative duty — this order is a confirmed accessibility fix, not the literal site value.
Do tint every shadow with plaster-800 brown in light mode (rgba(43,38,32,…)) and black in dark mode — never neutral gray.
Do tile the brand mark on bg-card, never on bg-primary/gold.
Do use the app's own shadcn radius scale (--radius: 0.625rem-derived) for all app-shell surfaces, not the marketing site's corner values.
Do let Input rely on its own border-input bg-transparent styling; don't re-override it per screen.
donts: Don't reintroduce a multi-theme accent picker. Exactly one accent (gold) exists in the shipped build; document theming as mode-only (light/dark) if at all.
Don't override Input's base border/background per page (the removed border-border bg-muted auth pattern was a legibility regression, not an alternate valid style).
Don't fill nav active-state rows solid gold; the confirmed pattern is the bg-primary/10 text-primary soft-tint pill.
Don't redraw, recolor, or reinterpret the logo file — treat public/brand/logo.png and its fixed crop math as the only source of truth for the mark.
